visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a mustache in a denim jacket stands in front of a red Japanese temple structure with a large red lantern. He gestures towards the camera. (2) Close-up shots of hands browsing chocolate shelves in a Japanese supermarket, focusing on Meiji boxes. (3) A woman with a pearl necklace and white top holds multiple boxes of chocolate, smiling at the camera in a brightly lit indoor environment. (4) Hands open a box of Meiji Pistachic chocolates; chocolate balls are poured out, and a cross-section showing a whole pistachio is displayed. (5) The man eats a chocolate ball in front of the temple; stylized firework graphics explode from his mouth to signify flavor. (6) The woman gives a thumbs-up while tasting the chocolate in a sunlit outdoor area. (7) Scene shifts to a busy urban street at night with neon signs; the man holds a Meiji Macadamia box. (8) Close-up of the macadamia chocolate being bitten, revealing the nut inside. (9) The man is in front of the Tokyo Skytree during the day, holding Meiji Almond chocolates and explaining the product features. (10) Another man joins to taste the almond chocolate, showing a positive reaction. (11) Final sequence shows the man holding various Meiji products like Galbo and Kinoko no Yama with the Skytree background, gesturing enthusiastically.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Meiji Pistachio -> Meiji Macadamia -> Meiji Almond -> Product Compilation -> Brand Slogan Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a travel-oriented food recommendation guide, specifically promoting Meiji chocolate products to tourists in Japan. By combining energetic tasting reviews with iconic Tokyo backdrops, it creates an association between the brand and the Japanese travel experience.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Prominent display of Meiji packaging, detailed verbal praise of the products, and direct commands to buy these chocolates when visiting Japan.
